name: Mons Mouton (IM-2 Athena site)
source: LROC (NASA/GSFC/Arizona State University), 'IM-2 Athena Seen Obliquely' (image 1408): lander at 84.7906°S, 29.1957°E.
notes: Intuitive Machines IM-2 landing site, March 2025; former VIPER target region.

name: Connecting Ridge
source: Local maximum of the published LOLA average-illumination map (NASA GSFC PGDA product 69, AVGVISIB_85S_060M_201608 (Mazarico et al. 2011 method, 18.6-year average solar illumination, 60 m/pix)); corresponds to Site 01 (Connecting ridge) in the PGDA south-pole site list (numbering of Mazarico et al. 2011). Brightest pixel of the whole south-polar map.
notes: Ridge between Shackleton and de Gerlache craters. Earlier entry 89.45°S, 222.69°E (Mazarico et al. 2011, 240 m DEM) moved 2.9 km to the 60 m product maximum.

name: Shackleton rim
source: Local maximum of the published LOLA average-illumination map (NASA GSFC PGDA product 69, AVGVISIB_85S_060M_201608 (Mazarico et al. 2011 method, 18.6-year average solar illumination, 60 m/pix)); corresponds to Site 04 (Shackleton rim) in the PGDA south-pole site list (numbering of Mazarico et al. 2011).
notes: Rim of a 21 km crater whose floor is permanently shadowed.

name: de Gerlache rim
source: Local maximum of the published LOLA average-illumination map (NASA GSFC PGDA product 69, AVGVISIB_85S_060M_201608 (Mazarico et al. 2011 method, 18.6-year average solar illumination, 60 m/pix)); corresponds to Site 11 (de Gerlache rim) in the PGDA south-pole site list (numbering of Mazarico et al. 2011).

name: Malapert massif
source: Local maximum of the published LOLA average-illumination map (NASA GSFC PGDA product 69, AVGVISIB_85S_060M_201608 (Mazarico et al. 2011 method, 18.6-year average solar illumination, 60 m/pix)); corresponds to Site 23 (Malapert massif) in the PGDA south-pole site list (numbering of Mazarico et al. 2011).
notes: Near-side facing massif about 5 km high.

name: Shackleton crater floor (shadow reference)
source: Point inside Shackleton crater that the published PGDA map classifies as permanent shadow (DN = 0). Contrast case, not a landing site.
notes: Deep-crater reference for the terrain sanity check.

name: Shiv Shakti point (Chandrayaan-3)
notes: Outside the polar DEM tiles used here, so terrain is unavailable for this site.

source: Definition. Used for the polar-limit validation checks.
notes: Azimuth 0 here points along the 0° meridian.
